h1.en: Reading Diesel 120 Concrete Pump with a picture from Engineering drawing

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. Main-unit weight is is 8000 kg. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Engineering_drawing.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油120型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm。理论输送量是100 m³/h，最大出口压力是40 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Engineering_drawing。

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Engineering_drawing. Subject: Engineering drawing. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. The frame “Excavator” shows A cable-operated excavator under the Northwest (now Terex) name at the Pageant of Steam grounds and is not a site measurement of this model. Distance entries, where the sheet lists them, keep their own labels. Max. Outlet Pressure is 40 MPa. None of these is a price, a service life or a country list.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Engineering_drawing。画面主体：Engineering drawing。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油120型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm。目录如果另标出了距离格，那些格仍用自己的标题。液压泵 Kawasaki 112 (two units)。

body.en: Main-unit weight is is 8000 kg. Dimensions (L×W×H) is 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. Subject: A cable-operated excavator under the Northwest (now Terex) name at the Pageant of Steam grounds. Hopper capacity is 0.6 m³.
body.zh: 理论输送量是100 m³/h，最大出口压力是40 MPa。主体：A cable-operated 挖掘机 under the Northwest (now Terex) name at the Pageant of Steam grounds。

body.en: Those figures describe the machine body, not the pipeline. Main-unit weight is is 8000 kg. A wider-looking machine in a frame is not a higher Theoretical Output. Maximum aggregate size is 6 cm and below.
body.zh: 画面「Excavator」的主体是A cable-operated 挖掘机 under the Northwest (now Terex) name at the Pageant of Steam grounds，不是这个型号的工地实测。画面里机器看起来更宽，并不等于理论输送量更高。

body.en: Theoretical Output is 100 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 40 MPa. Millimetres and kilograms do not become metres of pipeline. The shown output stays 100 m³/h. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112 (two units).
body.zh: 外形尺寸是7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm。最大骨料粒径 6 cm and below。

question.en: On this row: Is that the pumping distance?

answer.en: No. Frame figures are body size or mass, not pipeline metres. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Engineering_drawing.
answer.zh: 不是。外形数字是机身尺寸或质量，不是管路米数。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Engineering_drawing画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: 100 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Engineering_drawing.
